remarks: SUMMER SEASONAL RENTAL - August availability. Looking to escape the city for a countryside retreat in a private setting that provides plenty of room for entertainment, an in-ground heated pool, tennis court, golf chipping area, trampoline & opportunities to explore the mature gardens? Look no further...Experience all that summer has to offer at your own private summer camp. Sprawling 5 bedroom, 5.5 bath country ranch on 4+ private acres. Spend warm summer days by the pool, host your own tennis tournament or play games on the rolling lawn. Enjoy relaxing summer nights dining al fresco by the pool or watching shooting stars sitting by the firepit - life doesn't get better than this. Many recent updates to this home give it a chic modern vibe. This rental is $36K a month. For rentals less than a month it is $9K a week.
